name: MeanReversion
summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy that buys when the current bar's low is the lowest over a configurable lookback period, and sells when the current bar's high is the highest over the same lookback period. Take profit is set at the midpoint between the highest and lowest prices, while stop loss is symmetrically placed on the opposite side. Position sizing is calculated to limit risk per trade to a configurable percentage of account balance.
summary_zh: 该EA实现均值回归策略，当当前K线低点为可配置回溯期内最低时买入，当当前K线高点为回溯期内最高时卖出。止盈设在最高价与最低价的中点，止损对称地放在另一侧。仓位大小根据账户余额的可配置风险百分比计算。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于均值回归：当价格触及回溯期内的极端低点时买入，认为价格将回归均值；当价格触及回溯期内极端高点时卖出，预期价格回落。入场条件为当前K线的低点是lookback根K线中的最低值（买入），或当前K线的高点是lookback根K线中的最高值（卖出）。出场条件为止盈设在最高价与最低价的中间值（均值），止损通过2*入场价-均值对称计算得出。仓位管理采用逐步增加手数的方式，使用OrderCalcProfit计算每手数的潜在亏损，直到亏损超过账户余额的risk_per_trade百分比为止。资金管理通过CheckMoneyForTrade函数检查可用保证金是否足够开仓。然而策略存在明显缺陷：同一时间只允许持仓一个（PositionsTotal>0即返回），止损对称计算在非对称波动市场中可能不合理，且缺乏滑点过滤、新K线检查和信号确认机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on mean reversion: buy when price hits the extreme low over the lookback period, expecting reversion to the mean, and sell when price hits the extreme high, expecting a pullback. Entry conditions are that the current bar's low is the lowest among the lookback bars (buy), or the current bar's high is the highest among the lookback bars (sell). Exit conditions set take profit at the midpoint between the highest and lowest prices (the mean), while stop loss is calculated symmetrically as 2*entry_price minus the mean value. Position sizing uses an incremental loop that increases lot size via OrderCalcProfit until the potential loss exceeds risk_per_trade percent of account balance. Money management includes a CheckMoneyForTrade function that verifies sufficient free margin before opening a position. However, the strategy has notable flaws: only one position is allowed at a time (PositionsTotal>0 returns immediately), the symmetric stop loss calculation may be inappropriate in asymmetric volatility markets, and there is no spread filter, new bar check, or signal confirmation mechanism.

parameters.name: lookback
parameters.description: 回溯期K线数量，用于确定最高价和最低价
parameters.description_en: Lookback bar count for determining high and low prices

parameters.name: risk_per_trade
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比（占账户余额）
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade (% of account balance)

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，均值回归理念直观易懂
仓位管理根据风险百分比动态计算，控制单笔最大亏损
开仓前检查保证金是否充足，防止因资金不足导致的交易失败
止损止盈对称设置，风险回报比理论上为1:1
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, with an intuitive mean reversion concept
Position sizing dynamically calculates based on risk percentage, controlling maximum loss per trade
Margin check before opening positions prevents trade failures due to insufficient funds
Symmetric stop loss and take profit setup provides a theoretical 1:1 risk-reward ratio
cons: 仅在价格创回溯期新低/新高时入场，在趋势行情中会频繁逆势交易导致连续亏损
止损对称计算（2*价格-均值）不考虑市场波动率的非对称性，可能设置不合理
缺少新K线检查，同一根K线的每个tick都会重复评估信号，可能导致重复下单逻辑问题
没有滑点/点差过滤，在点差较大时开仓可能面临不利成交价
PositionsTotal>0的限制过于简单，不允许同方向加仓或不同品种持仓
cons_en: Entries only on new lookback-period extremes, causing frequent counter-trend trades during trending markets leading to consecutive losses
Symmetric stop loss calculation (2*price - mean) ignores market volatility asymmetry and may produce unreasonable stop levels
No new bar check means every tick re-evaluates signals, potentially causing redundant signal processing within the same bar
No spread filter, so opening positions during high spreads may result in unfavorable fill prices
PositionsTotal>0 check is overly restrictive, preventing same-direction pyramiding or multi-symbol positions
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制（使用isNewBar模式），避免同一根K线内重复触发信号
添加点差/ATR过滤，在高波动或高点差环境下禁止入场，并使用ATR动态计算止损距离替代对称计算
增加趋势过滤器（如长期均线方向），避免在强趋势行情中逆势开仓
improvements_en: Add a new bar check mechanism (isNewBar pattern) to prevent repeated signal triggers within the same bar
Add spread/ATR filter to prevent entries during high volatility or wide spread conditions, and use ATR-based dynamic stop loss instead of symmetric calculation
Add a trend filter (e.g., long-term moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trending markets

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，同一根K线内可能多次触发信号评估
止损对称计算不考虑市场波动率特征，可能在低波动时止损过大或高波动时止损过小
均值回归策略在趋势行情中容易连续亏损
risk_points_en: No new bar check, potentially triggering signal evaluation multiple times within the same bar
Symmetric stop loss calculation ignores market volatility characteristics, possibly resulting in stops that are too wide in low volatility or too tight in high volatility
Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses during trending markets
